title: HW MIDI engine, not answering
about: The HW MIDI engine is chosen and the Monomachine has not answered: lifecycle hwLost, the emulator-only capabilities off with their reasons, the engine menu says why EMU is unavailable, and a notice offers a way on.

machine.lifecycleText: The Monomachine has not answered for a while. Check the MIDI cables and that its SYSEX is on.

send.title: Monomachine not answering
send.text:
Nothing has answered on the MIDI ports for 3.5 s.
Check the cables and that SYSEX is on in the Monomachine's global settings.
